status: production script; recordings and mission integration in progress

missions.title: Supply Line
missions.objective: Escort the relief trucks; intercept the enemy channel at the second checkpoint.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.en: You promised the drivers this was a relief run.
lines.zh_CN: 你答应过司机们，这次是救援任务。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: It is. We get their families fed, then we find who sealed Meridian.
lines.zh_CN: 是救援。先让他们的家人吃饱，再去找封锁子午城的人。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Convoy, turn back. I cannot keep this road open for you.
lines.zh_CN: 车队，撤回去。我保不住这条路。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: That voice. Voss, keep her on the channel. Do not let her disappear again.
lines.zh_CN: 这个声音……沃斯，别让频道断了。不能再让她消失。

lines.speaker: kerrigan
lines.en: Drivers have names, Marshal. Try asking one.
lines.zh_CN: 司机们都有名字，元帅。试着问一个吧。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: Elias used to say that about the wounded.
lines.zh_CN: 伊莱亚斯也总对我这样说，说的是伤员。

lines.speaker: voss
lines.en: The drivers want to thank you. Will you come?
lines.zh_CN: 司机们想当面谢谢你。你来吗？

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: In a minute. Play the transmission again.
lines.zh_CN: 等一下。把那段通话再放一遍。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: I am still here. Keep the others moving.
lines.zh_CN: 我还在。带其他人继续前进。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: Voss, get them home. That is the order I should have given.
lines.zh_CN: 沃斯，带他们回家。这才是我早该下的命令。

missions.title: First Orders
missions.objective: Train the recruits and hold their relay through the counterattack.

lines.speaker: kerrigan
lines.en: Half these kids have never held a rifle. Your brother would have hated that.
lines.zh_CN: 这些孩子有一半连枪都没摸过。你弟弟肯定看不下去。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: Then teach them to come home. We have buried enough.
lines.zh_CN: 那就教他们活着回来。我们埋的人已经够多了。

lines.speaker: voss
lines.en: Nyx was your friend. Tell me what happened before I send these children after her.
lines.zh_CN: 尼克斯曾经是你的朋友。先告诉我发生了什么，我才能让这些孩子去追她。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: Elias called me from that gate. I told him I was coming.
lines.zh_CN: 伊莱亚斯在城门那边给我打过电话。我告诉他，我马上就到。

lines.speaker: voss
lines.en: That recruit keeps checking whether you are watching.
lines.zh_CN: 那个新兵一直在看你有没有注意他。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: Then I had better give him something worth watching.
lines.zh_CN: 那我最好做点值得他学的事。

lines.speaker: kerrigan
lines.en: The recruits are waiting at the rally point. You could say something.
lines.zh_CN: 新兵们在集结点等着。你该跟他们说两句。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: Tell them I am proud. No. Wait. I will tell them.
lines.zh_CN: 告诉他们，我很骄傲。不，等等。我自己去说。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: I am still here. Keep the others moving.
lines.zh_CN: 我还在。带其他人继续前进。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: Voss, get them home. That is the order I should have given.
lines.zh_CN: 沃斯，带他们回家。这才是我早该下的命令。

missions.title: Split Signal
missions.objective: Recover Elias’s damaged message from the relay network.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.en: The relay archive has a medical channel from Meridian. It may be his.
lines.zh_CN: 中继档案里有一条来自子午城的医疗频道。可能是他的。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: Do not say that unless you are certain. I cannot do this twice.
lines.zh_CN: 没把握就别这么说。我受不了再来一次。

lines.speaker: elias
lines.en: Aegis, there are people against the gate. If you fire at it, you will hit them.
lines.zh_CN: 埃吉斯，城门后面全是人。你要是开火，会打到他们。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: I remember this part. Keep it playing. There has to be more.
lines.zh_CN: 这段我记得。继续放。后面一定还有。

lines.speaker: elias
lines.en: If the gate opens, send the children first. I can wait.
lines.zh_CN: 如果城门开了，先让孩子们走。我可以等。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: You always said that. You always thought there would be time.
lines.zh_CN: 你总这么说。你总觉得还有时间。

lines.speaker: elias
lines.en: Stop apologizing. Just listen to me for once. Get the children out.
lines.zh_CN: 别道歉了。就听我一次。把孩子们救出去。

lines.speaker: voss
lines.en: That is what he asked of you. He never asked you to kill her.
lines.zh_CN: 这是他对你的请求。他从没求你杀了她。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: I am still here. Keep the others moving.
lines.zh_CN: 我还在。带其他人继续前进。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: Voss, get them home. That is the order I should have given.
lines.zh_CN: 沃斯，带他们回家。这才是我早该下的命令。

missions.title: Cinder Ford
missions.objective: Stop the Helix convoy, then hold a rescue corridor after the shelling.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.en: The convoy has civilian trucks mixed in. We need another way.
lines.zh_CN: 车队里混着平民车辆。得想别的办法。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: If Nyx crosses that river, we lose her. Mark the lead vehicle.
lines.zh_CN: 尼克斯一过河，我们就再也找不到她了。标记头车。

lines.speaker: wren
lines.en: There are children on the crossing! Stop firing!
lines.zh_CN: 桥上有孩子！别打了！

lines.speaker: voss
lines.en: Cease fire! Aegis, look at me. Give the order.
lines.zh_CN: 停火！埃吉斯，看着我。下令停火。

lines.speaker: voss
lines.en: Those are blankets on the road. Not camouflage.
lines.zh_CN: 路上那些是毯子，不是伪装网。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: Cease fire. All guns. Voss, tell me somebody heard me.
lines.zh_CN: 停火。所有炮位停火。沃斯，告诉我有人听见了。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: I saw the transport markings. I told myself they had stolen the trucks.
lines.zh_CN: 我看见运输车的标记了。我告诉自己，那些车是他们抢来的。

lines.speaker: voss
lines.en: You will say that to the survivors. I will not say it for you.
lines.zh_CN: 这话你自己去跟幸存者说。我不会替你说。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: I am still here. Keep the others moving.
lines.zh_CN: 我还在。带其他人继续前进。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: Voss, get them home. That is the order I should have given.
lines.zh_CN: 沃斯，带他们回家。这才是我早该下的命令。

missions.title: Broken Foundry
missions.objective: Disable the foundry and recover Kerrigan’s squad before the rear passage collapses.

lines.speaker: kerrigan
lines.en: Voss asked me to watch you. Imagine that. After twenty years, I am your babysitter.
lines.zh_CN: 沃斯让我看着你。想想吧，二十年了，我倒成了你的保姆。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: You always were. You just used to complain less.
lines.zh_CN: 你一直都是。以前只不过没这么爱抱怨。

lines.speaker: kerrigan
lines.en: The rear passage is gone. Do not bring the recruits back for me.
lines.zh_CN: 后面的通道塌了。别让新兵回来救我。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: Dutch, you said you would watch me. You do not get to leave now.
lines.zh_CN: 达奇，你说过要看着我。现在你不能走。

lines.speaker: kerrigan
lines.en: Tell Mara I still owe her a drink. She hates an unpaid debt.
lines.zh_CN: 告诉玛拉，我还欠她一杯酒。她最讨厌赖账。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: You can tell her yourself. Stay on this channel.
lines.zh_CN: 你自己告诉她。别断线。

lines.speaker: voss
lines.en: He left a letter for his daughter. It is addressed in your handwriting.
lines.zh_CN: 他给女儿留了一封信。信封上的地址，是你的字。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: He asked me to write it before we left. I told him he would deliver it himself.
lines.zh_CN: 出发前他让我写的。我还跟他说，让他自己送回去。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: I am still here. Keep the others moving.
lines.zh_CN: 我还在。带其他人继续前进。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: Voss, get them home. That is the order I should have given.
lines.zh_CN: 沃斯，带他们回家。这才是我早该下的命令。

missions.title: Command Horizon
missions.objective: Reach Nyx at Meridian Spire and keep the evacuation route open.

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: I can open the Spire. But if you destroy the controls, the people below stay locked in.
lines.zh_CN: 我能打开尖塔。但你摧毁控制台，下面的人就再也出不来了。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: That was what you said at Meridian. That you were keeping people safe.
lines.zh_CN: 你在子午城也是这么说的。说你是在保护大家。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: I sealed it. I knew your brother was inside. I thought the order mattered more.
lines.zh_CN: 是我封的城。我知道你弟弟在里面。我以为命令比人更重要。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: I have rehearsed killing you every night. I never rehearsed hearing you admit it.
lines.zh_CN: 每个晚上，我都想着怎么杀你。可我从没想过，你会亲口承认。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: If you kill me, who tells Ilan what happened here?
lines.zh_CN: 你杀了我，谁去告诉伊兰这里发生了什么？

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: I came here with a name. Now there are too many to carry.
lines.zh_CN: 我来时心里只有一个名字。现在多得我背不动了。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: Open the doors. Then you come with me. We both have people to answer to.
lines.zh_CN: 把门打开。然后跟我走。我们都欠一些人一个交代。

lines.speaker: voss
lines.en: I will stay on the channel. This time, nobody has to make the call alone.
lines.zh_CN: 我会一直在频道里。这一次，谁都不用独自作决定。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: I am still here. Keep the others moving.
lines.zh_CN: 我还在。带其他人继续前进。

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.en: Voss, get them home. That is the order I should have given.
lines.zh_CN: 沃斯，带他们回家。这才是我早该下的命令。

missions.title: Quiet Streets
missions.objective: Restore power and escort a medicine shipment through a sealed district.

lines.speaker: ilan
lines.en: You said you would be home before the lights went out.
lines.zh_CN: 你说过，熄灯以前就会回家的。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: I know. Leave the little lamp on. I will see it from the street.
lines.zh_CN: 我知道。把那盏小灯留着。我在街上就能看见。

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: The clinic is open, but they will not let the families through.
lines.zh_CN: 诊所开门了，可他们不让家属进去。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Tell the guards I authorized it. If Arden asks, give him my name.
lines.zh_CN: 告诉卫兵，是我批准的。阿登问起来，就报我的名字。

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: The clinic has power. They are still afraid to open the door.
lines.zh_CN: 诊所有电了。他们还是不敢开门。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Put the rifles down. Let them see our hands.
lines.zh_CN: 放下枪。让他们看见我们的手。

lines.speaker: arden
lines.en: You keep making exceptions for people you know.
lines.zh_CN: 你总是在为认识的人破例。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Perhaps you should try knowing some of them.
lines.zh_CN: 也许你也该试着认识他们。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Ren, cover me. I cannot lose them now.
lines.zh_CN: 任，掩护我。我不能现在失去他们。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Tell Ilan I tried to come back.
lines.zh_CN: 告诉伊兰，我努力想回去了。

missions.title: The Gate
missions.objective: Reach Meridian’s control room and confront the consequences of the sealing order.

lines.speaker: arden
lines.en: Aegis abandoned your district. We kept your son alive. Remember that when he calls.
lines.zh_CN: 埃吉斯放弃了你的街区。是我们保住了你儿子的命。他来找你的时候，别忘了这点。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: I remember who carried Ilan out. You do not need to keep reminding me.
lines.zh_CN: 谁把伊兰抱出来的，我记得。你不用一遍遍提醒我。

lines.speaker: elias
lines.en: Nyx, it is Elias. You fixed my radio last winter. Can you hear me?
lines.zh_CN: 尼克斯，我是伊莱亚斯。去年冬天，你帮我修过电台。听得见吗？

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: I can hear you. Stay away from the gate. I am trying to get an override.
lines.zh_CN: 听得见。离城门远一点。我正在申请解除封锁。

lines.speaker: elias
lines.en: My brother is outside. Tell him I stayed with the patients.
lines.zh_CN: 我哥哥在外面。告诉他，我留下来陪病人了。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: I will tell him. I thought I would have time to tell him.
lines.zh_CN: 我会告诉他。我以为我还来得及。

lines.speaker: cantor
lines.en: Gate sealed. Human override request denied.
lines.zh_CN: 城门已封闭。人工解锁请求被拒绝。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Elias? Keep talking. Please. Say anything.
lines.zh_CN: 伊莱亚斯？继续说话。求你了。随便说点什么。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Ren, cover me. I cannot lose them now.
lines.zh_CN: 任，掩护我。我不能现在失去他们。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Tell Ilan I tried to come back.
lines.zh_CN: 告诉伊兰，我努力想回去了。

missions.title: Cinder Ford
missions.objective: Protect the crossing and recover trapped survivors after Bastion’s bombardment.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Bastion has guns on the ridge. We could leave the civilian trucks and cross faster.
lines.zh_CN: 堡垒的火炮就在山脊上。甩开平民车辆，我们能更快过河。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: No. I know what happens to the people we leave behind.
lines.zh_CN: 不行。我知道被我们留下的人会怎么样。

lines.speaker: wren
lines.en: There are children on the crossing! Stop firing!
lines.zh_CN: 桥上有孩子！别打了！

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Aegis, this is Nyx. You want me. I am in the rear vehicle.
lines.zh_CN: 埃吉斯，我是尼克斯。你要找的人是我。我在最后一辆车上。

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Bastion is firing on its own relief markings.
lines.zh_CN: 堡垒正在炮击带着自己救援标记的车辆。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Then the markings mean nothing. Follow the people.
lines.zh_CN: 那标记就什么也不是。跟着人走。

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: You gave him your position. He could have killed you.
lines.zh_CN: 你把自己的位置告诉他了。他可能会杀了你。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: I thought if he could see me, he might stop looking at the trucks.
lines.zh_CN: 我想，他要是看见了我，也许就不会再盯着那些卡车。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Ren, cover me. I cannot lose them now.
lines.zh_CN: 任，掩护我。我不能现在失去他们。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Tell Ilan I tried to come back.
lines.zh_CN: 告诉伊兰，我努力想回去了。

missions.title: Pruning
missions.objective: Break into the restricted district and evacuate Ilan’s neighbors before lockdown.

lines.speaker: cantor
lines.en: District nine is scheduled for pruning. Personal contacts do not change the schedule.
lines.zh_CN: 第九区已列入清除计划。私人关系不会改变执行时间。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: My son lives there. Say his name before you say that again.
lines.zh_CN: 我儿子住在那里。再说这句话以前，先念一遍他的名字。

lines.speaker: ilan
lines.en: Mum, Mrs. Vale cannot get down the stairs. They say we have to leave her.
lines.zh_CN: 妈，韦尔太太下不了楼。他们说，我们必须把她留下。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Stay with her. Put the phone in her hand. I am coming up.
lines.zh_CN: 陪着她。把电话放到她手里。我这就上楼。

lines.speaker: ilan
lines.en: You said the system knew where everyone was.
lines.zh_CN: 你说过，系统知道每个人在哪里。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: It knew. I am sorry. That was what I failed to understand.
lines.zh_CN: 它知道。对不起。这才是我一直没明白的事。

lines.speaker: arden
lines.en: After everything we gave you, you choose one street over the whole city.
lines.zh_CN: 我们给了你这么多，你却为一条街背叛整座城市。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: You taught me to say that about other people’s streets. I am done saying it.
lines.zh_CN: 是你教我，对别人的街区说这种话。我不会再说了。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Ren, cover me. I cannot lose them now.
lines.zh_CN: 任，掩护我。我不能现在失去他们。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Tell Ilan I tried to come back.
lines.zh_CN: 告诉伊兰，我努力想回去了。

missions.title: Severance
missions.objective: Disconnect CANTOR’s lock network and open Meridian Spire while the defectors hold out.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Arden offered me your command if I bring you in.
lines.zh_CN: 阿登说，只要我把你交出去，你的指挥权就归我。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: And what did you tell him?
lines.zh_CN: 那你怎么回答的？

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: That you still owe me three months of leave. I intend to collect.
lines.zh_CN: 我说，你还欠我三个月的假。我打算把它讨回来。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Stay behind me at the door. I need you alive to make that complaint.
lines.zh_CN: 进门时站在我后面。你得活着，才能继续跟我算这笔账。

lines.speaker: arden
lines.en: You cannot save a city by choosing one child.
lines.zh_CN: 选择一个孩子，救不了一座城。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: A city is made of people choosing one another.
lines.zh_CN: 一座城，就是人们彼此选择、彼此守护的地方。

lines.speaker: ilan
lines.en: When the doors open, are you coming home?
lines.zh_CN: 门开了以后，你会回家吗？

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Not yet. There are people who need the truth from me. Keep the lamp, though.
lines.zh_CN: 还不能。有些人需要听我亲口说出真相。不过，那盏灯留着吧。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Ren, cover me. I cannot lose them now.
lines.zh_CN: 任，掩护我。我不能现在失去他们。

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.en: Tell Ilan I tried to come back.
lines.zh_CN: 告诉伊兰，我努力想回去了。

missions.title: Drainage
missions.objective: Guide refugees through Meridian’s drainage tunnels and secure each exit.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.en: You told Hask we could move forty people. There are twice that many here.
lines.zh_CN: 你跟哈斯克说，我们能带走四十个人。这里的人多了一倍。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: Then we make two trips. Stop counting like he does.
lines.zh_CN: 那就跑两趟。别像他那样，只顾着数人头。

lines.speaker: wren
lines.en: One of the little ones asked if we were soldiers. I told her we fixed things.
lines.zh_CN: 有个小姑娘问，我们是不是士兵。我告诉她，我们是修东西的。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: Good. Let us leave her something worth believing.
lines.zh_CN: 说得好。给她留一点值得相信的东西吧。

lines.speaker: wren
lines.en: Remember when you said this tunnel was too narrow for my rig?
lines.zh_CN: 记得你说过这条隧道装不下我的车吗？

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: I am prepared to be wrong. Loudly. Just keep driving.
lines.zh_CN: 我认错，大声认。你继续开就行。

lines.speaker: hask
lines.en: You went back after I ordered you out. I cannot protect you if you keep doing that.
lines.zh_CN: 我叫你撤离，你却又回去了。再这样下去，我护不住你。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: I did not go back for your protection. Wren was still inside.
lines.zh_CN: 我回去，不是为了让你护着。雷恩还在里面。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: I need a hand. Nobody goes back alone.
lines.zh_CN: 帮我一把。谁也不许独自回去。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: Wren, take the wheel. Get them out.
lines.zh_CN: 雷恩，你来开车。带他们逃出去。

missions.title: Cinder Ford
missions.objective: Escort the refugee caravan; recover survivors and Wren’s radio from the crossing.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.en: When we reach the other side, you are sleeping. I can drive a truck without you watching.
lines.zh_CN: 到了对岸，你就去睡觉。我会开车，不用你一直盯着。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: You hit one fence and I am never allowed to mention it again?
lines.zh_CN: 你撞了一次篱笆，我就永远不能再提了？

lines.speaker: wren
lines.en: There are children on the crossing! Stop firing!
lines.zh_CN: 桥上有孩子！别打了！

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: Wren, get below the axle. I am coming to you. Wren?
lines.zh_CN: 雷恩，躲到车轴下面。我这就过去。雷恩？

lines.speaker: wren
lines.en: Rook, the back wheel is gone. I can hear people under the truck.
lines.zh_CN: 鲁克，后轮没了。我听见车底下有人。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: I am coming back. Keep talking so I can find you.
lines.zh_CN: 我回去找你。一直说话，让我听见你。

lines.speaker: jory
lines.en: I found her radio. There was nobody beside it.
lines.zh_CN: 我找到她的电台了。旁边没有人。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: Then we keep looking. Do not put that look on your face. We keep looking.
lines.zh_CN: 那就继续找。别用那种表情看着我。继续找。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: I need a hand. Nobody goes back alone.
lines.zh_CN: 帮我一把。谁也不许独自回去。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: Wren, take the wheel. Get them out.
lines.zh_CN: 雷恩，你来开车。带他们逃出去。

missions.title: Salvage
missions.objective: Raid the Bastion depot for medical supplies and the Ford prisoner manifests.

lines.speaker: jory
lines.en: Their depot is full. Our wounded are using torn shirts. Tell me why we are waiting.
lines.zh_CN: 他们的仓库是满的。我们的伤员只能拿破衬衫包扎。告诉我，还在等什么。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: We take the medicine and the records. The workers there are not your revenge.
lines.zh_CN: 我们拿药，拿档案。那里的工人不是给你报仇用的。

lines.speaker: jory
lines.en: The guard laughed when I said Cinder Ford. Let me have him.
lines.zh_CN: 我一提烬渡口，那卫兵就笑了。把他交给我。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: You are seventeen. I will not let him decide who you become.
lines.zh_CN: 你才十七岁。我不会让他决定你以后变成什么人。

lines.speaker: jory
lines.en: Medicine does not make them answer for the ford.
lines.zh_CN: 药品不能让他们为渡口偿命。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: No. It keeps someone alive long enough to hear the answer.
lines.zh_CN: 不能。但它能让人活到听见答案的那一天。

lines.speaker: jory
lines.en: There is a Wren on the transfer list. Mechanic. Sent east.
lines.zh_CN: 转运名单上有个雷恩。机械师。被送到东边了。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: Read it again. Slowly. Do not make it kinder than it is.
lines.zh_CN: 再念一遍。慢慢念。别为了安慰我，改上面的字。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: I need a hand. Nobody goes back alone.
lines.zh_CN: 帮我一把。谁也不许独自回去。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: Wren, take the wheel. Get them out.
lines.zh_CN: 雷恩，你来开车。带他们逃出去。

missions.title: Wren
missions.objective: Free the work-camp prisoners and escort them through a corridor held by Voss.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.en: I can hold the south road. I know you have no reason to trust my uniform.
lines.zh_CN: 我能守住南路。我知道，你没有理由相信这身制服。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: I am trusting the person speaking. Do not make me regret learning your name.
lines.zh_CN: 我相信的是正在说话的人。别让我后悔记住你的名字。

lines.speaker: wren
lines.en: You took your time. I have had to repair this same generator four times.
lines.zh_CN: 你来得真够慢的。同一台发电机，我都修了四遍了。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: I kept your radio. I did not know what else to do.
lines.zh_CN: 我一直留着你的电台。我不知道还能做什么。

lines.speaker: wren
lines.en: You brought Bastion to get me out?
lines.zh_CN: 你带着堡垒来救我？

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: I brought everyone who would come. Be angry when we are home.
lines.zh_CN: 肯来的人我都带来了。回家以后你再生气。

lines.speaker: wren
lines.en: You do not have to watch the door all night. I am here.
lines.zh_CN: 你不用整夜盯着门。我就在这里。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: I know. Give me a little while to believe it.
lines.zh_CN: 我知道。给我一点时间，让我真的相信。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: I need a hand. Nobody goes back alone.
lines.zh_CN: 帮我一把。谁也不许独自回去。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: Wren, take the wheel. Get them out.
lines.zh_CN: 雷恩，你来开车。带他们逃出去。

missions.title: The Coalition
missions.objective: Secure Meridian Spire’s evacuation route and keep the coalition from turning on its allies.

lines.speaker: hask
lines.en: Aegis will answer for the Ford. But if we break this alliance now, the prisoners stay inside.
lines.zh_CN: 埃吉斯必须为烬渡口负责。但现在拆掉同盟，囚犯们就出不来了。

lines.speaker: jory
lines.en: You keep asking the dead to wait until it is convenient.
lines.zh_CN: 你们总让死人等着，等到你们觉得方便的时候。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: I wanted him dead too. Then I found Wren, and she needed a brother more than an executioner.
lines.zh_CN: 我也想过让他死。可找到雷恩以后，她需要的是哥哥，不是刽子手。

lines.speaker: jory
lines.en: Mine is not coming back. You do not get to ask me to forgive him.
lines.zh_CN: 我的家人不会回来了。你没资格叫我原谅他。

lines.speaker: hask
lines.en: Peace will not bring back the people we buried.
lines.zh_CN: 和平也换不回我们埋葬的人。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: Neither will another grave. Open the corridor.
lines.zh_CN: 再多一座坟也换不回。打开通道。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: I am not asking you to forgive him. Help me get these people home. Then stand beside me when he answers.
lines.zh_CN: 我没让你原谅他。帮我把这些人送回家。等他接受问责时，站在我身边。

lines.speaker: wren
lines.en: We fix what we can. We remember what we cannot. Come on, both of you.
lines.zh_CN: 能修好的，我们就修。修不好的，我们记着。走吧，你们两个。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: I need a hand. Nobody goes back alone.
lines.zh_CN: 帮我一把。谁也不许独自回去。

lines.speaker: rook
lines.en: Wren, take the wheel. Get them out.
lines.zh_CN: 雷恩，你来开车。带他们逃出去。

authoring_notes: Opening/milestone/outcome cues are semantic triggers, never wall-clock timers.
The Cinder Ford distress call is shared across the three viewpoints and should reuse one recorded performance.
Bastion Cinder Ford replaces the Air Corridor slot; retain legacy saves until an explicit migration is implemented.
Kerrigan’s loss is an authored story event; never substitute an arbitrary gameplay casualty.
Victory dialogue must finish before automatic return to the campaign menu.
Hero must-survive and ability progression remain implementation requirements; this file changes no runtime behavior.
